records.text: Mike Cernovich, whom Owens said listeners might know, tweeted on April 16, 2018 about an energy shift and said high-consciousness people he had spoken to independently felt a shift
records.speaker: Mike Cernovich

appearances.snippet: And then on April 16th, Mike Cernovich—you might be familiar with him—he does this series of tweets, having not spoken to me or Charlie (Charlie Kirk) about how we were feeling, saying that he was speaking to a lot of his friends who could feel that there was some sort of an energy shift happening. ... He wrote, "A change in energy." This is Mike Cernovich. "A change in energy which stuns high consciousness people does not mean bad. It simply means that it's cosmic. A paradigm is shifting. Something is happening, and that people get angry at me shows the shift." "Why care? The energy manifests itself in different ways." He goes on to say, "Several high consciousness people I've spoken to independently told me about feeling a shift in energy. Something is going on. It happened two to three weeks ago. I'm not talking politics or elections. It's much bigger. Energy shift."
